snippet.title: Heavy as Stone - Official Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026
snippet.description: You’re sick. So is the city. Explore a crumbling Terminal that loops when you die. Solve cursed investigations. Weaponize your symptoms. Find the truth, or spiral with it. Check out the trailer for Heavy As Stone, an upcoming exploration horror investigation game. Heavy As Stone will be available on Steam and Xbox Series X/S.
